intro: Elder Skychaser is an ancestral spirit who manifests during the Lunar Festival atop the Sentinel Tower in Westfall. Honoring her allows travelers across the dust-swept plains to pay homage to the wisdom of ages past. In return, the elder acknowledges the burning vigor of the living and grants her blessing.

paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
